notes.title: Important information for users of the Spanish version
notes.content:
Due to a contract with a publisher we were forced to remove all third-party content. As the result, the Spanish translation we introduced earlier will no longer be available. 

[b]Can you still play the game in Spanish? Yes![/b] Please check the following topic in the community discussions where you'll wind a download link to the Spanish version: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1413600/discussions/0/3194737075892423260/

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience this may have caused. A contract with a publisher is an important step in the company development. All current actions are motivated by our desire to improve our existing and future games.

If you have any questions, we'll answer them below.

notes.title: Happy Conquistador joins the family of Facesit Inc.
notes.content:
The “Adult Only” visual novel Happy Conquistador tells the story of Enrique, a Spanish conquistador who embarks on a mission vital for the Spanish Empire. Lead the ship through the ocean, fight for gold and lands, and bring glory to the Spanish Crown.

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1896250/Happy_Conquistador/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39157251/932b372fa581fefb1899382dde9b0ae9bc8d5c95.jpg[/img]

Our next game, Happy Conquistador, will feature more freedom of choice than you can imagine.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39157251/6d3a213f1cc2287e1cb94fcfa028c0fcbaaa6356.jpg[/img]

The main character will visit Arabian peninsula, jungles of Western Africa and a Chinese coastal town. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39157251/b7ebcdea649d9531197321919bf53401a0837f1e.jpg[/img]

He will encounter female companions, engage in romantic (or not so romantic relationships). The CG art, as always, will be presented in form of a gallery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39157251/823c83545c0aa3c2d9a2010014e37b7414313b62.jpg[/img]

Soon, we will be publishing development diaries, where the features of the upcoming game will be presented in detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39157251/95d66502d33043bc6e7d5c3d6f944b224f4e935f.jpg[/img]

We also plan further updates to our first game Meowhalla. The time is not decided yet, but it will likely launch together with the new game’s release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39157251/481722db71210760c26b468706058320941fce3d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Your review = a feedback for us
notes.content:
Dear all, 

Writing a review is one way to deliver your feedback to us. We worked hard to make this game happen, but we would like you to share any propositions or concerns with us. For example, one of the reviews so far suggested some bugs with the achievement registration, and we were able to react and fix the issue. 

Alternatively, if for some reason you are unwilling to make a review, you may submit any feedback in the comments below, and we will engage into discussions. This post is specifically designed for the conversation with the developers.

Otherwise, enjoy your experience with M.A.I.D.s and save the world!

notes.title: M.A.I.D.s is released!
notes.content:
It was a long journey, but finally M.A.I.D.s have arrived on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39157251/183cd9fe95857cb5d773b26a2e009e61d503c716.png[/img]

Have you ever dreamed of your vacuum cleaner becoming your girlfriend? Of course you have. M.A.I.D.s is a visual novel featuring four humanized household items; the action takes place in the U.S. in 2020. Experience ultimate satire over the events of the year: from the pandemic to the elections. As the head of a family that consists of a vacuum cleaner, a dishwasher, a blender and a dispenser, you will struggle to reconcile girls in conflict and live through the pandemic and the complex realities of everyday U.S. life. As a bonus, the novel includes erotic artwork in the unlockable gallery.

notes.title: M.A.I.D.s launches on June, 25th!
notes.content: We are glad to announce that the build review was successfully finished and the game can be released. We need few more days to make some final adjustments to the marketing campaign. Thus, the new release date is planned on 25th of June.

notes.title: Important announcement about the release
notes.content:
Important announcement ❗️

Our project "M.A.I.D.s" was ready on the 1st of May. However, it is still being reviewed by Steam and we do not know when the review process will be finished. Thus, we regret to inform you that the release date is postponed until the review is finished.

Once we receive the approval, the game will be released at once.

notes.title: M.A.I.D.s – Development Diary 4
notes.content:
The story of M.A.I.D.s covers two weeks from the life of a human-android family. Each passing day will bring new adventures and challenges. In the end, heroes would find their fates in hands of a mysterious and hostile power. Everyday comical situations are intertwined with greater events, and seemingly insignificant choices influence the surrounding world. 

Currently, our visual novel is completed as follows:

-	The script is 100% complete;
-	Sprites are 100% complete;
-	Gallery is 100% complete;
-	Backgrounds are 100% complete;
-	Interface is 90% complete (we need to make some final adjustments and wait for the main menu background). 

We would like to show you a short gameplay video from the prologue: 

[previewyoutube=jcs-aq96hKY;full][/previewyoutube]

Do you remember our male sidekicks? They will appear more or less frequently in several scenes. However, we also have a “second-grade” sidekicks, destined to appear only ones or twice. For them, we prepared the side images. That is how they look:

A little more information about our gallery. The gallery will include biographical description for main characters. Each main character will have two gallery items with censored and uncensored version, plus several of them will have more. Here is our gallery panel:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39157251/16ad1c4f249ebf1d39fb013ed878b6f88a373cf5.jpg[/img]

An example of the gallery’s screen with biographical details:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39157251/1c102447fcc74d5077132e0407e236877aebb6c0.jpg[/img]

Interface development is ongoing, but we are ready to show the dialogue window, fonts and more:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39157251/4f5e1ea0a4a7085c2f3171d1d63d0cf2337bc8c5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39157251/bdfc0898ebcfb0a1ed56760975af921f473435fb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39157251/24204f52d1bb980dd7683ebfa2166149b487533c.jpg[/img]

Currently, we still have to conclude our beta-test and fix the remaining issues, as well as to continue our work on the interface and marketing campaign. 

The game is released on June, 11. Save the date!

notes.title: M.A.I.D.s - Development Diary 2
notes.content:
M.A.I.D.s is rather a comedy than an erotic game. The gallery, nudity and sex scenes are merely additional features, which are making the game more “alive” and also provide additional interest to those who love this type of content. In turn, we prefer to emphasize the vast satire ranging from the circumstances surrounding the pandemic to the issue of U.S. politics and elections. We laugh about all conflict parties, without taking a side. 

The novel will provide approx. 10 choices, which differ from our previous game (Meowhalla). It was feeling too short because the initial choices led to several different outcomes, which blocked another half of the script. In M.A.I.D.s, we introduced the invisible point system: each choice doesn’t influence the narration but rather only the ending you get. Each ending has approx. 1500-2000 words of unique text (3 endings in total). We are happy to announce that the overall world count has almost reached 70.000 words, more than we have initially expected. The censored version (if we get it approved, it’s still undecided though) will be 5.000 words shorter.

Currently, our visual novel is completed as follows:

-	The script is 100% complete (submitted to the proofreading);
-	Sprites are 30% complete (will be finished in March in full);
-	Gallery is 90% complete (we are still expecting final arts for the uncensored version);
-	Backgrounds 75% complete;
-	Interface 0% complete.
